name: Thunderbursts
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level cleric/oracle 8, druid 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a brass bell)

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area a 30-ft.-radius spread, centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, deafening sound bursts forth from your body in all directions. The sound does not harm objects or creatures in the area you wish to exclude from damage. Any other creatures within the area take 1d8 points of sonic damage per caster level (maximum 20d8) and are stunned for 1 round. A successful save halves the damage and negates the stun effect.
